title: Coding AgentのSandbox脱出(Codex Heapjack/Overpatch)が正式Advisory・CVEなしで修正され、利用者が影響Versionを判別できない
summary: Codex Desktopでは、Node REPLの共有V8 heapから検証Tokenを読み取ることで、最も厳しいread-only Sandboxでも承認なしでHostコマンドを実行できた(Heapjack)。Codex CLIでは、apply_patchとSymlinkの組み合わせでworkspace-writeの範囲を全Filesystemへ広げられた(Overpatch)。どちらも8月に修正済みだが、OpenAIは正式Advisory・CVEを出さず、9月の第三者公開で初めて周知された。悪意あるRepositoryを開いて質問するだけで成立するため、Sandbox modeの表示を信頼の根拠にはできない。

evidence.summary: Codex CLI 0.149.0: 'Prevent apply_patch from widening write permissions' (#39614), symlink hardening, 'Enforce filesystem permissions when loading AGENTS.md'. No advisory wording.
CSA research note (third-party) on Heapjack (Desktop build 26.818.21641 fix) and Overpatch (CLI 0.149.0 fix); OpenAI issued no formal advisory, only spokesperson confirmation.

affected_scope.description: Codex Desktop before build 26.818.21641, Codex CLI < 0.149.0

notes: The official release-note evidence predates the window (2026-08-20). The in-window evidence is the CSA disclosure (2026-09-22), which is third-party, not official tier. The Overpatch symlink mechanism also bears on P-20260907-211DB41F. The material change is that a sandbox escape was fixed without an advisory or CVE, so users cannot map their exposure to a version.
